{{Quote|I've never killed a Jedi before. This will be fun.|The Dark apprentice|<ref name="Jedi's Legacy" />}}
A '''Dark Jedi apprentice''' was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yabosta]] along with some [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] thugs to eliminate an agent of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Niquon]]. Unknown to her masters, the agent was actually a Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. The Dark apprentice watched the Padawan's movements on the planet before eventually attacking him. Unfortunately for the apprentice, the technician [[Lowghen Badra]] helped the Jedi escape.<ref name="Jedi's Legacy" />

==Personality and traits==
This apprentice was not particularly competent. She was sent to Yabosta instead of another apprentice, [[Von Totha]], because her masters did not realize that [[Nason Laric]] was a Jedi Padawan.<ref name="Jedi's Legacy" />
